subject.title: refactor: consolidate provider streaming and discovery tests

question: After a refreshed source-level review, should this broad but test-only fixture consolidation be accepted as the canonical structure for the three provider suites?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and the cross-provider consolidation require an explicit owner judgment that reduced repetition does not obscure provider-specific regression contracts.

options.title: Review and retain the consolidation
options.body: Confirm every replaced fixture preserves the original provider-specific assertions, then merge the test-only refactor.

options.title: Narrow the shared helpers
options.body: Keep only helpers that remain obviously provider-local and restore any abstraction that hides a distinct protocol contract.

recommendation.title: Review and retain the consolidation
recommendation.body: Confirm every replaced fixture preserves the original provider-specific assertions, then merge the test-only refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: The available metadata identifies this person as the author of the current provider-test consolidation; broader ownership history needs a normal repository inspection.
